checks.name: browser_snapshot_capacity_and_catalog_growth
checks.result: Local Chromium 156 isolated origin accepted a single localStorage value of at most 5,242,872 characters in this probe. A 10,000-item SQLite fixture took 4,308,992 Base64 chars; a 100,000-item fixture took 43,805,356 and does not fit. At 100,000 items index build was 3.464 s and query p95 88.704 ms (100 synthetic disk-backed queries). This disqualifies full-database localStorage snapshots for larger catalogs, not Kotlin as a language.

checks.name: browser_indexeddb_snapshot_comparison
checks.result: Chromium IndexedDB persisted a 33,087,488-byte SQLite catalog with 100,000 synthetic items. SHA-256 matched after page reload; observed write 600.600 ms and read 309.500 ms in one run. This verifies capacity and byte integrity, not the latency or atomicity of a production SQLite adapter.

checks.result: Local Chromium: 100,000-row catalog, same sale contract, first-write abort, abort over committed snapshot, successful replay after reload, and coordinated two-tab startup all verified. Whole-snapshot experiment; CI pending.
